why: failed AI calls cost nothing, history lists charges and refunds, shown in Settings in both languages, tests and changelog
prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows the credit history under the credit balance. Its columns are when, what it was for, and the amount. Charges are red and negative, and refills and refunds are green and positive. Refunds read "Refund: <action>" in English and "환불: <action>" in Korean. I added the en/ko strings, with the same keys in both files and a label for every priced action, and a CHANGELOG bullet. `tsc --noEmit` is clean and eslint reports no errors on the page (7 warnings, one fewer than before). I haven't looked at the page in a browser, so the layout is unchecked. The list reloads when the workspace or its credit balance changes.

+class CreditHistoryItem(BaseModel):
+    amount: int
+    action: str
+    created_at: datetime
+
+@router.get("/{workspace_id}/credits/history", response_model=List[CreditHistoryItem])
+def get_credit_history(
+    *,
+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    workspace_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Credit changes of a workspace, newest first. Members only; anyone else gets 404.
+    """
+    member = session.exec(
+        select(WorkspaceMember)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == workspace_id)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.user_id == current_user_id)
+    ).first()
+    if not member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_WORKSPACE)
+
+    transactions = session.exec(
+        select(CreditTransaction)
+        .where(CreditTransaction.workspace_id == workspace_id)
+        .order_by(CreditTransaction.timestamp.desc())
+    ).all()
+    return [
+        CreditHistoryItem(amount=t.amount, action=t.action_type, created_at=t.timestamp)
+        for t in transactions
+    ]

+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def ws_id(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def history(client, h, wid):
+    return client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=h)
+
+
+def test_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    wid = ws_id(client, h)
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "T", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    r = history(client, h, wid)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items] == [
+        (15, "refund_generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+    ]
+    assert all(i["created_at"] for i in items)
+
+
+def test_history_includes_daily_refill(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    wid = ws_id(client, h)
+    client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{wid}", headers=h)  # triggers the daily refill
+    items = history(client, h, wid).json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items] == [(50, "daily_refill")]
+
+
+def test_non_members_get_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    wid = ws_id(client, h)
+    assert history(client, other, wid).status_code == 404
+    assert history(client, other, "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000").status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history").status_code == 401
diff --git a/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ae7f928
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/tests/test_credit_refunds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,116 @@
+"""Users must not pay for AI work that failed."""
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def make_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_character(client, h, project_id):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/characters", headers=h, json={"name": "Mina", "project_id": project_id})
+    assert r.status_code in (200, 201), r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_is_charged(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == before - 15
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_workflow_cover_and_sheet_are_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/art-style", headers=h, json={"art_style": "ink"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.post(
+        f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": cid, "name": "Mina", "description": "tall", "style": "ink"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_style_preview_is_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "black ink"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_synchronous_ai_calls_are_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    calls = [
+        ("/api/v1/projects/worldview/augment", {"description": "a city", "title": "t"}),
+        ("/api/v1/projects/styles/recommend", {"description": "soft"}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/render", {"prompt": "a bus", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/structure", {"script": "a bus", "project_id": pid}),
+        ("/api/v1/scenes/modify", {"original_image_url": "http://x/y.png", "instruction": "red", "project_id": pid}),
+        (f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}/episodes/ideas", None),
+    ]
+    for url, body in calls:
+        try:
+            r = client.post(url, headers=h, json=body) if body is not None else client.post(url, headers=h)
+            assert r.status_code >= 400, (url, r.status_code)
+        except RuntimeError:
+            pass  # endpoint lets the AI error escape as a 500
+        assert credits(client, h) == before, url
+
+
+def test_failed_character_text_calls_are_refunded(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    calls = [
+        ("/api/v1/characters/augment", {"project_id": pid, "name": "Mina", "tags": [], "mood": "calm"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggest", {"project_id": pid, "type": "name"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/analyze", {"project_id": pid, "name": "Mina"}),
+        ("/api/v1/characters/suggestions/batch", {"project_id": pid}),
+    ]
+    for url, body in calls:
+        r = client.post(url, headers=h, json=body)
+        assert r.status_code >= 400, (url, r.status_code, r.text)
+        assert credits(client, h) == before, url
